Microsoft Windows 10 List functions in a category

params.name: dll
params.description: Filter by DLL name (e.g., kernel32.dll, user32.dll)

items.docs: Retrieves the list of Win32 API functions within a specified category. Each function includes its DLL, parameters, return type, and minimum supported version information.

info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Get Win32 function details

items.docs: Retrieves detailed information about a specific Win32 function including its syntax, parameters, return value, remarks, requirements (minimum supported client/server, header, library, DLL), and related functions.
